{{Documentation}}
== Purpose ==
Icon-plus-name-plus-description box used by '''pdxparse''' output for national
focuses, ideas and national spirits.

This template exists because <code>{{tl|Iconbox}}</code> is already taken on
several Hearts of Iron IV mod wikis (Old World Blues and Equestria at War both
use it for achievement lists, where the icon is derived from the achievement
name and an <code>image=</code> parameter is ignored). Installing the Paradox
wiki version of <code>Iconbox</code> over those would break existing pages, so
pdxparse output targets this separate name instead.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Focusbox|image=GFX_focus_generic_war.png
| Prepare for War
| Our armies must be ready for what is to come.
}}
</pre>

=== Parameters ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| <code>image</code> || no || File name of the focus icon, ''including'' the extension. Omitted entirely if the icon is unknown.
|-
| <code>1</code> || yes || Localised focus name.
|-
| <code>2</code> || no || Localised focus description.
|-
| <code>size</code> || no || Icon width. Defaults to <code>64px</code>.
|}

== Notes ==
* Degrades gracefully: with no <code>image</code> it renders name and description only, so a missing icon file never leaves a broken-image box in a table cell.
* Uses flexbox rather than a table so it reflows on narrow screens and inside <code>class="mildtable"</code> cells.
